scenes.script_line: There is a temptation in this unit, and it is worth naming: because the register is more informal, it is easy to let the standard slide with it. They are not the same thing. Informal means no linen tablecloth and no formal address. It does not mean a badly washed glass, a toilet nobody is checking, or a twenty-minute wait with nobody saying anything. The register changes; the standard does not. If you keep one line from this module, keep that one.

scenes.script_line: And there is something the bar team needs to see clearly: to anyone walking off that beach and into the bar, you are Craveiral. Many of those people have never slept on the farm and perhaps never will. That glass, that plate, that good morning is the only sample of the brand they will get. A good hour in that bar sells room nights we will never be able to attribute to anyone. A bad hour closes doors we never knew we closed.

scenes.script_line: Two operational demands the beach makes and the farm does not. The first is time. On the beach people get hungry at unpredictable hours and have short patience under the sun. A wait time communicated — “it is twenty minutes, shall I bring you water meanwhile?” — settles ninety per cent of complaints before they exist. What generates a complaint is not waiting; it is waiting without information. The second is sun and water. Shade, cold water, toilets checked hourly, attention to children and older people at midday. Wellbeing on the beach is mostly reducing physical discomfort nobody puts into words.

scenes.script_line: And because we are on a Costa Vicentina beach, inside a protected area, there is a coherence that is not negotiable. We do not let plastic loose in the wind. We collect what is ours and some of what is not. We close the day with the sand in front of us better than we found it. A bar that lives off the beauty of that coast and dirties it is the most visible contradiction this group can produce — and it is visible to hundreds of people a day, not to an annual audit.
scenes.visual_direction: A single plastic cup tumbling across empty sand in the wind at dusk, then a hand catching it. No faces, deserted beach. Low sun, long shadows. Palette: sand, dusk blue, white. 6 seconds. No text, no branding.
